_about: REAL committed cases for the verbatim-span check (vinci/verbatim.py). Each quote is the committed dossier/graph quote at 545403de (or one piece of it, see committed_quote); each window is a verbatim slice of the cited EDGAR document as the extractor read it (source_text). EDGAR filings are public domain. expect is the check's answer on the window AND on the whole document (asserted when built; re-asserted against EDGAR by the network-marked test).
